title: Two-level reduction of finite smooth purity
statement: For positive prime-power levels r≥m and any supplied geometrically normalized finite smooth levels a,b [def-pur-finite-smooth-adjunction-data], the actual quotient maps form ReductionData. The root comparison is normalized by its power map into G_m and every scalar/root generator. The ordinary and pro-etale compact, exceptional, counit, naturality, pullback, purity and constructibility assertions retain the original canonical maps. This is the two-level result sk-lem-sp-reduction, separate from triple-level quotient coherence.

source.place: sk-thm-smooth-purity and proof: inverse diagonal orientation followed by the tensor map; sk-prop-sp-orientation.proof.md: diagonal, deformation, vector bundle; sk-lem-sp-reduction.proof.md and sk-lem-sp-reduction-compatibilities.proof.md: counit-defined coefficient comparisons and quotient cocycle. The ordinary-etale Noetherian formulation retains arbitrary ground fields.

proof.text: Use quotientRootLineComparison and quotientInverseOrientation. The proved ordinaryGammaCoefficient tensor calculation gives ordinary_purity. Ordinary scalar extension preserves the input constructible finite-Tor domain. The supplied ordinary purity isomorphisms at a,b and the pullback/twist isomorphism make the actual exceptional mate invertible. Its defining adjunction gives ordinary_counit; compactSupportMap_isIso gives ordinary_compact.

Apply quotientIntrinsicCtf on every scheme for reduction_ctf. On X,Y use the comparison-counit and ordinary-origin lemmas. The adjunction unit makes originReductionMap invertible; all factors of the actual proCompactCoefficientMap and proPullbackMap are consequently invertible on their domains. Their formulas are unchanged. Ordinary mate naturality and comparison counit naturality prove pro_natural.

Obtain the ordinary exceptional-domain hypotheses at the two levels from ordinaryExceptionalCtf, using prime invertibility on Y. Apply finiteProCoefficientCounitTransport for pro_counit. The existing proGammaCoefficient calculation transports the ordinary square to pro_purity. The supplied proGamma isomorphisms and the pro coefficient map make proLambda invertible by cancellation. Assemble the ten fields of ReductionData. No triple-level quotient coherence is used.

proof_origin.place: K2: coefficient-unit orientation, existing ordinary tensor calculation, intrinsic scalar realization, actual site transport and isomorphism cancellation. Triple-level coherence is unnecessary for two-level assembly.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteSmoothTwoLevelReduction
    (ell : ℕ) [Fact ell.Prime]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [HasCompactification f] [QuasiCompact f] [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (d : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d f]
    (hY : ∀ y : Y, IsUnit (ell : Y.presheaf.stalk y))
    (r m : ℕ) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hmr : m ≤ r)
    (a : Level ell r f d) (b : Level ell m f d) :
    Nonempty (ReductionData (FiniteReduction.quotient ell hmr) f d a b)
